options.name: action_disable
options.description: Disable actions from taking place when gateway events occur. The gateway will always be considered up.

options.name: alert_interval
options.description: Sets the time interval in milliseconds between checking for an alert conditions.

options.name: api_host
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the pfSense device.

options.name: api_key
options.description: An API key to use for authentication.

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: api_port
options.description: The port number of the pfSense API.

options.name: api_protocol
options.description: The protocol to use when connecting to the pfSense API.

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: data_payload
options.description: Sets the data payload to send in ICMP packets to gateway monitor IP.

options.name: descr
options.description: Sets a descriptions for the gateway.

options.name: disabled
options.description: Disable this gateway.

options.name: dpinger_dont_add_static_route
options.description: Prevents gateway monitoring from adding a static route for this gateway's monitor IP.

options.name: force_down
options.description: Always consider this gateway to be up.

options.name: gateway
options.description: Sets the IP address of the remote gateway.

options.name: gw_down_kill_states
options.description: Controls the state killing behavior when this specific gateway goes down. Killing states for specific down gateways only affects states created by policy routing rules and reply-to. Has no effect if gateway monitoring or its action are disabled or if the gateway is forced down. May not have any effect on dynamic gateways during a link loss event.

options.name: interface
options.description: Sets the interface this gateway will apply to.

options.name: interval
options.description: Sets how often ICMP probes will be sent in milliseconds.

options.name: ipprotocol
options.description: Sets the Internet Protocol version this gateway uses.

options.name: latencyhigh
options.description: Sets the threshold to consider latency as high. This value must be greater than `latencylow`.

options.name: latencylow
options.description: Sets the threshold to consider latency as low.

options.name: lookup_fields
options.description: The list of fields to use when looking up existing resources. This should be a list of field names that uniquely identify a resource.

options.name: loss_interval
options.description: Sets the time interval in milliseconds before packets are treated as lost.

options.name: losshigh
options.description: Sets the threshold to consider packet loss as high. This value must be greater than `losslow`.

options.name: losslow
options.description: Sets the threshold to consider packet loss as low.

options.name: monitor
options.description: Sets a different IP address to use when monitoring this gateway. This is typically only necessary if the gateway IP does not accept ICMP probes.

options.name: monitor_disable
options.description: Disable gateway monitoring for this gateway.

options.name: name
options.description: Sets a name for the gateway.

options.name: nonlocalgateway
options.description: Allows or disallows gateway IPs that are not a part of the parent interface's subnet(s).

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the resource should be present or absent.

options.name: time_period
options.description: Sets the time period in milliseconds over which results are averaged.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate SSL certificates when connecting to the API.

options.name: weight
options.description: Sets the weight for this gateway when used in a Gateway Group.
